platform: KXCI 91.3 Tucson Worldwide Digital Download-Link and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KXCI accepts worldwide releases as CDs, vinyl with a digital download, or MP3/WAV download links and requires detailed release, genre, explicit-content, biography, social and contact metadata. The official music mailbox is exposed through a protected/non-plaintext link, and asset selection, link permissions, email delivery and any physical shipment require owner review.

platform: KZSC 88.1 Santa Cruz RPM Electronic and International Music Director Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: KZSC publicly lists current RPM & Electronic and International Music Directors, but their email links are protected/non-plaintext and the page does not publish accepted formats, download permissions, release windows or package fields. A human must use the appropriate official inquiry route and obtain instructions before sending music, links or files.

platform: KALX 90.7 Berkeley Professionally Pressed CD and LP Airplay Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KALX currently accepts only physical professionally pressed CDs or LPs and explicitly rejects downloads, file transfers, Bandcamp/Spotify links, YouTube videos, CD-Rs and other digital forms. A human must confirm that eligible pressed media exists and approve packaging and international shipping before queue execution.

platform: KDVS 90.3 Davis Physical-Only New Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KDVS explicitly requires physical submissions and publishes separate USPS and courier addresses plus department-specific attention lines, including Electronic and Experimental. A human must select eligible physical media, choose the correct carrier/address and approve packaging and international shipping.

platform: KCSB 91.9 Santa Barbara All-Format Physical New Release and Demo Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KCSB invites new releases and demos with all formats welcome, but directs music submissions to the Music Director through separate USPS and courier mailing addresses rather than publishing a digital upload workflow. A human must determine the suitable physical format and approve packaging, carrier and international shipping.
